Its preview is fitted without deformation by the minimum source-pixel translation constrained to the declared uncertainty plus actual fit residual, not by lowering containment validation. This remains an unreviewed display estimate, not independent calibration.

neighbors.placement: minimum shape-preserving translation inside conservative source-pixel uncertainty envelope; estimated, not measured

processing: Least-squares affine carto-to-existing-display-site fit over all seven common corners. Roof pixels mapped by separate inferred aerial-to-carto least-squares fit. Containment must reach 98%; never replace a roof by a clipped parcel-shaped roof. For owner-confirmed corner lot 9 only, a minimum rigid translation may fit the unchanged polygon inside the lot if its length is bounded by the conservative sum of declared picking uncertainty (15 aerial pixels) and actual affine residual mapped back to aerial pixels (5.8623 max). Computed shift is 18.9484 pixels, inside the 20.8623-pixel envelope. This is explicitly a provisional placement compensation, NOT verification of real building boundaries. No heights, no extrusion, no neighbor shadows. Streets include approximate sidewalks, not measured lane widths.
limitations: Parcel polygons and roof outlines are different objects, shown with different styles.
Roof-to-lot assignments and both transforms are approximate, unreviewed; image roofs are not surveyed wall footprints.
Printed frontage is NOT used to stretch or move the preserved site or house.
Trees, roof overhang, resolution and inferred control points limit accuracy.
No BIM, cadastral boundary, north alignment or physical shadow validation follows from this preview.
